About the Scholarship

This RMIT chemical engineering scholarship is supported by an ARC Future Fellowship project. It is aimed at applicants with relevant preparation in responsive materials and membrane fabrication. Candidates should discuss the defined research topic and award terms with the named project contact.

Research Areas

  • Chemical engineering
  • Responsive materials
  • Membrane fabrication

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryAUD 33,826; page describes three-year support but annual basis needs confirmation

About RMIT University

RMIT offers research degrees in science, engineering and other disciplines. Its project scholarships connect doctoral research with defined academic or industry questions and list the support available for each position.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.rmit.edu.au/scholarships/research/phd-scholarship-in-chemical-engineering

Source: rmit.edu.au - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 31 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 December 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
